title: Drive Recorder App Setup
summary: Feedback centers on the drive recorder feature and app setup, with one clearly favorable comment and several fragments that only describe configuration steps or customer inquiries without stating an opinion.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the driver recorder as a valuable vehicle feature.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments discuss asking about the drive recorder and how to enable it through the app, warnings, privacy policy, and settings without expressing satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The sample is very small, and most fragments are undetermined rather than evaluative.
The topic is based on short excerpts that mainly describe setup instructions, so sentiment evidence is limited.
